title: Card Settlement of Failed-Sale Charges — Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
A seller who asks to spread a failed-sale charge on a Real Estate Service Contracts listing order settles it under a settlement plan and pays the first settlement payment directly by card; the payment is posted against the failed-sale invoice and applied to the oldest open invoice first.

**Prerequisite.** A seller's settlement payment toward listing-period service is not taken until the order's billing history carries the failed-sale charge invoice billed for that service.

Put another way, the settlement payment waits on the order's billing history showing the failed-sale charge invoice for the listing-period service; while the billing history shows no such invoice, no settlement payment is taken.

**Setting up the plan.** The settlement plan is set up once, before the seller has made any payment on the order, and the first settlement payment is the payment taken when it is set up.

**Scope.** For a failed-sale charge the seller asks to spread, and only for such a charge, the settlement plan replaces the single due date, the first settlement payment being taken when the plan is set up; every other failed-sale charge remains billed to the seller and due the plan's failed-sale charge payment period, in calendar days, after billing.

## Invocation: `pay_failed_sale_charge_by_card_a1a6aa51`

**Capability.** Pays, as the seller, toward a failed-sale charge billed on the real estate plan, by card. One call records one payment from the seller, with payment method card, against the failed-sale invoice named, dated today, for the amount given, and lowers the plan's invoice balance by that amount. A payment confirmation number is issued and returned; the payment then shows in the plan's billing history against that invoice.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `pay_failed_sale_charge_by_card_a1a6aa51` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `realty_contract_id` | the real estate contract (plan) number the failed-sale charge was billed on, as given to the customer by the Bridgewell representative | identifier text |
| `invoice_number` | the failed-sale invoice number being paid, as shown on the failed-sale charge in the plan's billing history and given to the customer by the Bridgewell representative | identifier text |
| `amount` | the amount to pay now | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents); recorded exactly as given |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries: `status` "paid" when the payment was recorded; `payment_reference`, the payment confirmation number (text); `invoice_number`, the failed-sale invoice paid; `amount`, the amount of the payment in USD with 2 decimal places; `payment_method` "card"; `entry_date`, today's posting date as YYYY-MM-DD; `invoice_balance`, the plan's invoice balance after the payment in USD with 2 decimal places.
